scope: Exported Ker POSIX UDP transport and current native IPv4/IPv6 adaptation; original Linux protocols with DPDK net_tap

features.description: IPv4/IPv6 socket flags, fd aliases, bind conflicts and unconnected errors
Zero-length datagrams, vector I/O, message batches, peek and truncation
Readiness, FIONREAD and queue drain
Connected source filters, AF_UNSPEC disconnect and recovery
SO_RCVTIMEO, MSG_WAITFORONE and nonempty recvmmsg timeout pointer
IPv4/IPv6 pktinfo, TTL/hop limit, TOS/tclass, software timestamp and CTRUNC
IPv4/IPv6 connected/unconnected ICMP error queues and SO_ERROR clearing
IPv4/IPv6 UDP_CORK, MSG_MORE, flush and close-without-flush
IPv4/IPv6 receive queue exhaustion, SO_RXQ_OVFL and recovery
UDP_SEGMENT and UDP_GRO byte/metadata boundaries
IPv4/IPv6 reuseport stable-flow delivery, member removal and rebind
IPv4-mapped UDP, IPV6_V6ONLY and independent IPv4 binding
IPv4 UDP API combinations against independent Linux peers
External IPv4 ICMP error queue and recovery
External IPv4 packet info/source selection/timestamps
External IPv4 cork and MSG_MORE
9000-byte MTU and jumbo UDP boundaries
IPv4 MTU, fragmentation and 65507-byte datagrams
UDP receive-low-water and MSG_WAITALL semantics
Blocking batch receive MSG_WAITFORONE
Consuming truncation and per-entry batch lengths
External socket receive timeouts and recovery
IPv4 ASM join/leave/fanout/rejoin and metadata
IPv4 source-specific multicast and third-source rejection
External IPv4 reuseport connected members and source demux
IPv4 subnet broadcast and SO_BROADCAST permissions
255.255.255.255 broadcast, three send APIs and unicast recovery
External IPv4 source filtering and UDP disconnect
IPv6 external pktinfo/timestamps/error queues/fragments/segmentation/ASM/SSM; both roles
IPv6 interface/DAD/NDP and on-link IPv6 UDP both directions
IPv6 global/link-local default gateways and actual routed UDP hop-limit decrease
IPv4/IPv6 real-router ICMP PMTU1280, route-cache update, local EMSGSIZE and recovery
IPv4/IPv6 checksum acceptance/rejection, reverse fragments, reassembly timeout ICMP, reordered/duplicate datagrams
Host SIGUSR1 interruption of native blocking UDP
features.note: Host recvfrom returns EINTR; native recvfrom remains blocked until configured SO_RCVTIMEO, then EAGAIN. This successful boundary probe is not a compatibility pass.

features.description: Physical NIC checksum/segmentation offload and multi-queue/RSS validation
features.note: This environment uses net_tap, single queue and disabled hardware offloads; software UDP_SEGMENT is separately exercised.

features.description: Long-duration resource/concurrency/fault/end-to-end performance acceptance
features.note: The automated matrix is bounded functional validation, not a long-duration stability or throughput qualification.

features.description: Native sendfile/splice/io_uring, genuine zero-copy and libc-internal DNS resolver compatibility
features.note: These runtime/application integration paths are outside the exported socket validation and are not claimed supported by this report.
